overall_reason: The brand site treats motion as a showpiece of its own guidelines: the Dropbox mark draws itself once (drawIn, 1.25 s), and each nav tile (Framework, Motion, Color) animates its own diagram on one shared token, --tile-transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); the one measured click ("Navigation menu") changed nothing on screen, so almost no timing was measured and the judgment rests on declarations.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE and T-MOTION-SYSTEM pass (a deliberate intro and one tile token), but T-CHOREOGRAPHY finds an intro whose declared delays hold the nav titles back about 2.5 s, and nothing was measured beyond one click.

findings.title: The page arrives once and is never gated
findings.evidence: The stylesheet delays the intro in steps: the gridlines fade over 1.5 s after a 0.75 s delay, the logo container resizes over 1.5 s after a 1 s delay, and the nav button titles fade in over 1.25 s after a 1.25 s delay, so the titles finish about 2.5 s after the class is set. The capture holds no frames of this sequence (no passive recording), so the timing is read from declarations, not measured.
findings.after: Keep the logo draw as the one intro moment and show the nav titles at once, or within about 300 ms of it
findings.why: Designers return to brand guidelines many times to find a logo file or a colour value, and a staged intro that holds the section names back for over two seconds costs them that time on each return.

strengths: The tile animations run on one declared token, --tile-transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), across 36 elements, so the guidelines' own motion reads as one system.
Each tile's motion shows its subject: the Motion tile draws a bezier curve with its handles and the Framework tile moves its connected points, so the movement is content, not decoration.
The Dropbox mark draws once with stroke-dashoffset (drawIn, 1.25 s) and does not loop; the live run found no snaps.
not_investigated: Passive motion: no passive recording, so the load intro (drawIn and the animating-in sequence) was read from declarations, not measured.
The "Navigation menu" click changed nothing on screen, so T-ENTER-EXIT and T-SPATIAL-MEANING had no element that opens.
Tile hover animations as they play: hover is not captured as frames; only the declared transitions were read.
T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP: the tiles are illustrations that hold their final drawing in the screenshot, and nothing loops.

Interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built. Gestures, scroll-driven motion beyond the load (the capture does not scroll while recording) and route transitions into each tile's page were not captured.
The sweep's reduced_motion check is not verified (one stylesheet could not be read), and the motion_css hits (MOT-001) belong to the sweep.
